design_static.command: python scripts/validate_suite.py && python -m unittest discover -s suite/tests/static -p "test_*.py" -v

runtime_adapter.state: test oracle specified; domain APIs not implemented; bind with suite/docs/ADAPTER_CONTRACT.md; MUST fail G1/G2 until executable evidence recorded

manual_gate.state: manual and CI evidence required (platform, performance, release); never count as automatically passed

deferred.state: out of P0; never make MVP gate fail merely because deferred code absent

gate_rule: P0 release requires every P0 MUST test actual PASS with execution record, and G0-E,G0-C,G1,G2,G3,G4 closed. Static-only completeness cannot satisfy release gate.
